shared_elements: animals or animal features (bird head in B, quadrupeds in A)
plant-like or vegetal element (schematic in A vs stylized rosette tree in B)
rows of repeated small marks (crew strokes in A, sign-like rows in B)
justification: Both surfaces show upright figures with raised arms and bands of small repeated marks, but these are generic and their forms differ completely: A is a scattered field of tiny schematic stick-figures, cattle and multi-oared boats, while B is a single large, anatomically modelled bird-headed winged figure holding a bucket and cone beside a stylized flowering tree with rosettes. There is no shared relationship or compositional scheme — A has no dominant figure or ground line and no vegetal centrepiece, B has no boats, herds or crowded scatter.
